item.text:
Use Mistral’s **[Compare Models](https://docs.mistral.ai/getting-started/models/compare)** page. It shows each model’s supported features, including function calling, agents, structured outputs, OCR, embeddings, transcription, text-to-speech, and batching.

For an API-level view, query **[GET `/v1/models/{model_id}`](https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/models)**; the response includes a `capabilities` object for the selected model.
